name: Beast-training kit
body:
Source Animal Archive pg. 12
Price 15 gp; Weight 26 lbs.
Category Animal Gear
Description
This kit includes a dandy brush, training harnessARG, training whipARG, whet bone, and 2 days’ worth of carnivore feed. The weight of this kit can be reduced by 10 pounds by forgoing the carnivore feed.
